n: Carnegie Mellon Robotics Academy NVIDIA Jetson Nano curriculum and JetBot AI training
t: A project-based AI course on the JetBot with a Jetson Nano for older students.
steps: Find the Jetson Nano curriculum on the CS2N site.
Buy a Jetson Nano, a JetBot kit, a 64 GB microSD card, and batteries.
Use a Windows or Mac laptop.
Work through Unit 1 to get started.
Consider the four-day onsite training for teachers.
